rapport_notes: Friendly and thorough discovery, but the call ended abruptly in pricing confusion rather than a clean close.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before we proceed, just wanna ask if you have any important concerns about this move' — asked right after address confirmation, before item-level probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer revealed he has no one to help with the king bed/couch; rep said 'yes sir the couch, mm-hmm I understand you, okay that's perfectly fine' and pivoted straight to boxes with no follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'once we go over the minimum we only charge in every fifteen minute intervals.'

top_strength: Opened with the agenda/concerns question early, before real logistics probing began.
coaching_note: Never gave a typical-range estimate anchor before quoting the flat $480 two-and-a-half-hour minimum — jumping straight to the floor price without framing likely caused the customer's confusion ('so it's $500?') and the call ending before a close could happen.
